svg.title: Clam ileocystoplasty
svg.desc: Ileum is opened along the antimesenteric border, reconfigured into a patch, and joined to the opened native bladder. This is the reservoir principle, not a complete operation. Mesenteric blood supply, bowel continuity, drainage and lifelong follow-up are not drawn. View: Bowel patch construction and bladder augmentation. Scale: Conceptual schematic; not to scale. Units: No measured geometry; any dimensions are illustrative. Clinical review pending; no named clinician has signed off. Concept sources: Barashi et al.: robot-assisted ileocystoplasty with appendicovesicostomy (2018 technical guide), https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29774817/; access: abstract checked; Bowel augmentation concept; exact bowel sizing, mesentery and closure sequence require operative review. EAU Neuro-urology: surgical treatment (2026 web guideline), https://uroweb.org/guidelines/neuro-urology/chapter/the-guideline; access: official full text; Reservoir augmentation and catheterizable diversion principles; long-term surveillance remains necessary. WARWIKI original vector schematic; individual illustrator not recorded. No separate figure reuse license recorded; linked sources are concept references, not artwork licenses.

svg.text: a detubularized ileal cup sewn onto the bivalved bladder makes a low-pressure, high-capacity reservoir
fold into a U / S-shaped cup
sew the cup onto the bivalved bladder
